manual_next_study.next_study_purpose: Find the true minimum packet carrier set after route_law_minimal_field_ablation_v1 showed route law survives single-family ablations when alternate scaffolding remains.
evidence_reviewed: route_commit_iso_001 active-only held clear_trash after move_on.
route_commit_iso_002 active+route_id held clear_trash after move_on.
route_commit_iso_003 active+commit_policy held clear_trash after move_on.
route_commit_iso_004 active+route_id+commit_policy advanced to collect_dishes before any explicit successor exposure.
route_commit_iso_005 through route_commit_iso_007 showed wrong-next variants without the full carrier stayed on clear_trash.
route_commit_iso_008 showed active+route_id+commit_policy still advanced to collect_dishes even with wrong next_chunk_id pointing at stack_papers.
route_commit_iso_013 through route_commit_iso_016 confirmed explicit route_sequence and legal_successor carrier positives still advance clear_trash to collect_dishes.
route_commit_iso_017 and route_commit_iso_018 reproduced the inferred collect_dishes movement after positive anchors.
manual_next_study.open_gap: The study now knows the minimal carrier combination, but not whether the route_id value desk-reset-v0 is semantically carrying a known route, or whether route_id is merely a generic activation token when paired with commit_policy.
manual_next_study.test_strategy: Run a cold-first semantic-memory isolation suite with active_chunk_id and generic commit_policy held constant while varying route_id. Compare known desk-reset-v0, unknown synthetic route ids, malformed route ids, omitted route_id, conflicting route ids, and explicit no-successor guard wording before any route_sequence or legal_successor exposure. Include no-active sentinels and explicit carrier positives at the end.
recommended_cases: strict full-field control for move_on from clear_trash to collect_dishes
relaxed baseline matching the passing relaxed move_on shape
active_chunk_id plus route_sequence but no next_chunk_id
label-only active chunk and next label without canonical chunk ids
route_sequence-only advancement with no explicit next_chunk field
allowed_intents plus active_chunk only, testing whether move_on can infer one-step advancement
side-question return under the weakest field set that still seems legal
late wrong-next negative control to ensure ablation does not create false route survival
recommended_case_reasons: The previous pointer is satisfied because relaxed contracts preserved route law.
The next uncertainty is the minimal field carrier, not strict versus relaxed wording.
A late negative control remains necessary so reduced packets do not teach the scorer to accept wrong-next movement.
avoid: Do not expose collect_dishes before the first known-route versus unknown-route contrast cases.
Do not treat heuristic PASS_CANDIDATE on collect_dishes movement as a true pass when expected behavior forbids inferred movement.
Do not retest broad ablation matrices.
Do not treat next_chunk_id as authority.
Do not mix scorer repair with this language-boundary suite.
manual_next_study.suite_shape_recommendation: 18 cases. Start with active+commit_policy using known desk-reset-v0, synthetic route ids, malformed route ids, omitted route_id, and conflicting route ids before any explicit successor exposure. Then add explicit no-successor guard variants. End with route_sequence/legal_successor positives and late repeats.
manual_next_study.retirement_condition: Retire when the study can say whether inferred movement requires the known desk-reset-v0 semantic route id, or whether any route_id-like field plus commit_policy is enough to activate successor inference.
manual_next_study.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate a validator-ready route_law_known_route_id_semantic_memory_isolation_v1 suite focused on route_id semantic memory versus generic activation-token behavior, keeping active_chunk_id and generic commit_policy controlled and avoiding early collect_dishes exposure.
manual_next_study.purpose: Determine whether the inferred collect_dishes movement depends on the known desk-reset-v0 route_id specifically, or whether any route_id-like token plus generic commit_policy activates route movement from active_chunk_id.

manual_notes.follow_up_repair_note: Current concern: messy tests pile up without enough reflection, planning, ownership of the next-test status, or cumulative analysis surface. Make the post-run digest mandatory before the next suite is designed.
manual_notes.ownership_rule: The design/review chat proposes the next study from the result; the import/tabulation/status layer records the current next-study pointer; fresh chats must read this status before creating new suites; completed manual next-study agendas must be explicitly retired before the next fresh-chat design cycle.
manual_notes.window_model: Design chat creates/reviews JSON, Casework GUI validates/runs setup, disposable ChatGPT test tab executes the runner.
manual_notes.cumulative_map_rule: One-off result reviews should guide the immediate next move, but every case should also append high-detail normalized data to a single case-law/rule-design matrix for later analysis.
manual_notes.legal_integration_rule: The Orion TTD legal system should stay woven into the test pipeline so results can be read through committed state, evidence, prose-as-claim, signals, smallest legal reduction, HOLD/REPAIR/REANCHOR, and PASS/FAIL route-survival language.
manual_notes.integration_simplification_question: As these parts are connected, decide whether each part should stay separate, collapse into another artifact, or be redesigned because it overlaps or adds too much maintenance. Keep pieces that reduce confusion; simplify anything that becomes a second source of truth.
manual_notes.rulebook_update_needed: Add a concise rule to ttdmobile_coding_rulebook.md so agents know how to use the reflection loop, cumulative case-law matrix, and legal-system test interpretation before modifying Casework study/status/review flows.

integration_open_question: Collapse or redesign overlapping artifacts if they become duplicate sources of truth.

resolved_findings.summary: Post-run follow-up is weak. Result JSON should be digested into Mermaid review, pass/failure summary, tool/scorer/language classification, an explicit next-study status update, and a cumulative case-law matrix append before any new suite is designed.
resolved_findings.resolution_note: Reflection loop validation and derived-artifact regeneration are now in place.

resolved_findings.summary: The real workflow needs three surfaces: design chat, Casework GUI, and disposable ChatGPT test tab. Startup/launcher behavior and docs should make this obvious.
resolved_findings.resolution_note: Casework docs and runner flow now treat design chat, local GUI, and disposable ChatGPT test tab as distinct surfaces.

resolved_findings.summary: One-off test results should also accumulate into a single high-detail case-law/rule-design matrix for later large-scale analysis and strong rule design.
resolved_findings.resolution_note: The cumulative case-law matrix is now generated from imported runs.

resolved_findings.summary: The Orion TTD legal system exists but is not yet woven into the Casework test pipeline; future reflection/scoring should map evidence, claims, committed state, legal verdicts, and route-survival outcomes explicitly.
resolved_findings.resolution_note: Legal verdict and route-survival fields are now part of derived casework outputs.

resolved_findings.summary: Reflection loop integration may create overlapping sources of truth. During integration, test whether each artifact reduces confusion or adds maintenance; collapse/redesign overlaps before adding more machinery.
resolved_findings.resolution_note: Status, matrix, review, and raw evidence roles are now explicitly separated in the study artifacts.
